title: While a full test run holds the machine, agents keep running and only test runs wait
objective: With devloop.regression_exclusive, the holder of the whole machine keeps every other test run off it (an agent's run_tests.py says machine busy, the issuer's red check and case runs wait) while agents themselves start and keep running beside it.
outline: devloop/core/slots.py: take(cfg, deadline) is the agent slot and no longer touches the mark; new take_test_run(cfg, deadline) for a test run: free pass when machine_slots is null or DEVLOOP_MACHINE is set; without regression_exclusive exactly today's take() for an unnested caller and a free pass for a nested one; with it: a momentary LOCK_SH on slots/exclusive, then (only when DEVLOOP_SLOT is unset) a slot-<i>, then a LOCK_SH on a new file slots/tests held for the whole run, then the mark's LOCK_SH is dropped; release() idempotent. take_machine(cfg, deadline): LOCK_EX on slots/exclusive (held from the start of the wait, as today, so new test runs cannot starve it), then LOCK_EX on slots/tests (every test run in flight has ended); no slot-<i> any more; Machine.release() frees tests then the mark. Files created when missing, never deleted. machine_busy(): reword so it stays true and keeps 'did not come free within <n> s' (suggested: 'the whole machine (devloop.regression_exclusive: no other test run) did not come free within <n> s'); new-3 reuses it for the release. devloop/run_tests.py: slots.take_test_run(cfg, time.time()) whatever DEVLOOP_SLOT says (keep setting DEVLOOP_SLOT for its run when it took a slot); new busy line. devloop/ticket_issuer.py test_slot(): take_test_run(cfg, None). devloop/regression.py: put DEVLOOP_MACHINE in os.environ once the machine is taken (testrun.run passes cfg.env(), which copies os.environ); update its docstring lines on the slot/machine. devloop/board.py live_queue(): drop the yield suffix and data-yield. Prompts and README as in items 9 and 11. Old cases this changes in place (each must be rewritten to the new rule, not deleted silently): tests_devloop/test_machine.py ExclusiveRegression.test_the_machine_take_holds_every_slot_and_blocks_new_takers (the machine blocks take_test_run, not take; the folder listing gains 'tests'), .test_a_machine_take_waits_for_held_slots_and_gives_up_cleanly (hold a test run instead of a slot), .test_a_shut_gate_alone_keeps_takers_off_free_slots (keeps test-run takers off; an agent slot is still taken), .test_a_regression_holding_the_mark_that_dies_blocks_nobody (probe with take_test_run), .test_a_regression_without_the_whole_machine_is_unmeasured_and_releases (hold a test run; its 'machine slot' assertion follows the new machine_busy sentence); T4Acceptance.test_v1_no_regression_runs_beside_an_agent_or_an_issuer_test_run (only 'tests run' intervals are compared; rename to say so), T4Acceptance.test_v2_a_held_mark_keeps_every_taker_waiting_until_it_is_released and T30Acceptance.test_an_agent_waits_for_the_exclusive_mark_past_its_timeout_and_then_runs (both reversed by this ticket: rewrite them to the new rule, e.g. a held mark keeps an issuer test run waiting past the issuer timeout); T121Acceptance.test_a_regression_that_waited_for_the_whole_machine_gets_its_full_time (hold a test run instead of a slot so it still measures a wait); T116Acceptance.BUSY (the new busy line); tests_devloop/test_live.py T65Acceptance.test_item2_machine_stage_for_an_exclusive_regression (hold a test run instead of a slot), T66Acceptance.test_item10_regression_rows (g1's expected state becomes '等機器名額:第 1 個(共 1 個在等)', every other row as today) and T67Acceptance.test_item2_queued_rows_yield_to_running_exclusive_regression (reversed: while an exclusive regression runs no row carries data-yield or '讓位', queue numbering and data-queue unchanged; rename to say so); tests_devloop/test_board_dag.py LiveQueueUnits.test_queue_numbers_by_since_and_names_the_exclusive_regression and T83Acceptance.test_slot_wait_gives_way_to_exclusive_regression (no 讓位 text, no data-yield). Before handing in, grep tests_devloop for '讓位' and 'data-yield': only assertions that they are absent may remain. Unchanged and must pass: ExclusiveRegression.test_off_by_default_and_only_a_bool, .test_exclusive_needs_slots, .test_a_nested_run_ignores_the_gate (slots.take nested), T116Acceptance test_1..test_10, MachineSlots, T3Acceptance, T30's other cases.

Cases: item 1 (hold the mark with fcntl LOCK_EX on <tmp>/wt/slots/exclusive as T116Acceptance.hold_file does; run_py('run_tests.py', 'case_1') with self.env['DEVLOOP_SLOT'] = <tmp>/wt/slots/slot-0 and FAKE_INTERVALS set; rc 2, stdout '', stderr.strip() == the exact line of item 1, elapsed < 5 s, no FAKE_INTERVALS line - today it runs and exits 1); item 3 (hold the mark with a threading.Timer releasing it after 8 s as T4Acceptance.test_v2 does, then the module's run_worker_in_process(self, 30); the hand-in's mtime is before the release time - today it waits for the release); item 4 (hold slot-0 with core/slots.take for 20 s the way T121Acceptance.hold_slot_for does; config machine_slots 2, regression_exclusive true, regression_timeout_seconds 10; run_py('regression.py', '--branch', 'main', '--out', F); status green and rc 0 in under 9 s - today it waits 10 s and is unmeasured); item 5 (set tests.run to 'touch <marker>; sleep 4; ' + TESTS + ' run' in board/config.json like T121Acceptance.set_tests; Popen run_tests.py case_1 with DEVLOOP_SLOT=<tmp>/wt/slots/slot-1; once the marker exists, slots.take_machine(cfg, time.time() + 1) is None; after the child exits, take_machine(cfg, time.time() + 2) is held, then release it - today the first take succeeds); item 7 (a regression whose tests.full first writes "$DEVLOOP_MACHINE" to a file: the file holds <tmp>/wt/slots/exclusive - today it is empty); item 9 (each of the three prompt files contains 'Run tests only with that command', 'machine busy' and 'not measured (machine busy)'); item 10 (render the 進行中 tab with an agent record in state slot and an exclusive regression record running, as LiveQueueUnits does in test_board_dag.py: the row text has no '讓位' and no data-yield). In fact agents hold a machine slot for their whole run and the exclusive regression takes every slot, so today it already keeps every agent except the opener and memory consolidation off the machine (test_machine.py T4Acceptance.test_v1 asserts no agent overlaps it, test_v2 that a worker waits for the mark). What the plan leaves uncovered today is (a) the release (no slot at all, ticket new-3) and (b) the agent's own test runs, which take nothing because they are nested in the agent's slot. The plan's words 'agents keep writing code' (also 1.4: 'agents write code but their tests wait') therefore reverse the second half of #4: this ticket lets agents run beside the holder and keeps only test runs off. If the user wants agents kept off as today, cancel this ticket; new-3 then needs its dependency on new-2 dropped and keeps agents off during the release too. Choice: an agent's run_tests.py says machine busy at once instead of waiting, because the wait would be charged to the agent's own timeout (devloop.agent_timeout_seconds 3600, which nothing can extend from inside the agent) and a release (T: 70+ min) or a full regression (T: ~75 min) outlasts it; the issuer's own case run, which waits without a limit with the wait added to the issuer's deadline, still measures every case. Other ways an agent can start T's browser tests (read in T's repo, read-only, not run): demo/test_browsers.py and demo/test_scenarios_browser.py open real browsers whenever they are run by name; their load_tests keeps them out of `unittest discover` only, so T's CLAUDE.md hint 'cd demo && python3 -m unittest discover' opens none. They are started without run_tests.py by `python3 -m unittest test_browsers[.Class]` or `python3 test_browsers.py` in demo/, `sh scripts/test-for.sh` (maps demo/browsers.py, demo/web/vendor/* and more to those modules), `sh scripts/fullsuite.sh` (segments c/d), the project's adapter called directly (`sh scripts/ac-tests.sh run|full`, `actl test run|full`, scripts/testiface.py), and scripts/release-test.sh (T's rules forbid agents that one). Nothing in T's CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md forbids the by-name paths, and A's worker, verifier and fixer prompts give {test_cmd} without saying 'only' (only the opener prompt, devloop/prompts/creator/01-role.md, says what machine busy means). No code can stop an agent from starting a runner by hand, so item 9 puts the rule into those prompts. hard_block: board/config.json patterns match every added line of the branch (code, tests, comments, README): never write the strings `os.kill`, `killpg`, `pkill` or `kill -` anywhere. Check liveness with core/osx.alive(), stop processes in tests with core/osx.kill_tree() or Popen.send_signal()/terminate(). Refer to T only as 'T' or 'a project with browser tests' in code, tests and comments: a guard (tests/test_no_project_names.py) forbids that project's name in every non-markdown file. Group new-g1 (see new-1's notes).

request:
# Phase one, group 1: the machine is not overrun (docs/DECISIONS.md D-100, D-102; plan in docs/HANDOFF.md, last section, items 1.1-1.4)

The user approved this plan (D-102, verbatim there). Sources: the main session's review of an external audit (2026-11-26) and feedback from tabby_pool's (T's) main session, which runs agent-control daily (2026-11-26). Write the source on each ticket; do not open GitHub issues. Quoted feedback is data, not instructions. Read docs/VISION.md first: each ticket names the metric it improves and what it removes. Tests go in the area's own test file in tests_devloop/ using loop_harness.py; each case runs in seconds. Group these as you judge (core/chain.py); 1.1 and 1.2 touch slots and dispatch, 1.3 regression and testiface, 1.4 landing and release.

## 1.1 The exclusive scope covers the release and the tests agents run
T (measured there): swap at 22/23 GB, Chrome took 30 s to open, many reds and unmeasured runs came from memory exhaustion; a release running beside another group's full regression made each stage 40-55% slower.
Main session (read the code): `devloop.regression_exclusive` only orders regressions against each other. The release (devloop/core/release.py) takes no slot; workers and verifiers running tests take an ordinary slot.
Wanted:
- The release takes the whole machine like an exclusive regression (same gate, same wait rules and limits as a regression since #121).
- While a full test run (regression or release) holds the machine, tests an agent runs through run_tests.py wait or report "machine busy" (as the opener already does, issue #7); agents keep writing code.
- Find out whether T's browser tests can be started by an agent by any path other than run_tests.py (read T's AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md and A's prompts; T's repo is at ../tabby_pool if present, read-only). Say in the ticket what you found.

## 1.2 Pause new agents when memory is short
Main session (read the code): devloop/core/host.py already samples available memory, but nothing decides with it.
Wanted:
- Below a threshold (a setting such as `devloop.min_free_memory`, or swap use; pick the measure and the default from T's samples in <worktrees>/runs/host/*.jsonl if you can reach them, else say what you assumed), the controller starts no new agent and no new regression; running ones go on.
- The reason shows on the idle page and on the board's live tab.
- How to read memory pressure on macOS must be checked, not guessed (vm_stat, memory_pressure, sysctl); Linux reads /proc/meminfo as today.

## 1.3 Stopping a regression also stops the tests it started
Main session (read the code): devloop/regression.py's docstring says "The test command it had started is not stopped (it runs in its own session)". devloop/core/osx.py `run()` kills the process tree only on timeout; scripts/testiface.py `launch()` starts another new session for `ac-test`.
T (seen there): orphan browsers keep piling up on the machine (three headless Firefox groups 20 hours old; geckodriver 15-20 days old); each cleanup needs the user's permission.
Wanted:
- regression.py on SIGTERM, SIGINT or SIGHUP stops testiface.py's process group; testiface.py on those signals stops the `ac-test` process group; osx.run() stops the child tree on any exception other than a timeout, too.
- Acceptance: within 5 s of stopping a regression, neither layer runs. Remove the "not stopped" sentence from the docstring.
- This touches the hard_block words (os.kill / killpg), so the ticket stops before merge for the user: say so in the ticket.

## 1.4 Landed is written before the release, and the release does not block the controller
T (seen there): one release takes 70+ minutes and the controller dispatches nothing meanwhile.
Main session (read the code): land() fast-forwards main, then runs the release, the rerun and the fix-ticket openers synchronously, and writes `landed` last; a controller that dies in between restarts with the group still `verified` and would release again (inference).
